import PortalLanding from "../../../components/PortalLanding.astro";

An **Agent Package** defines a reusable role and how it works. Publish a tested version as a template so a workspace can create a digital employee from it.

## Define an agent

Specify the result the agent should deliver, the inputs it needs, and when to hand the task back to a person. For a complete research assistant example, see [Agent definition](/build/employee-definition/).

| File                         | What to configure                                                                |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.aiworkforce/employee.yaml` | Responsibilities, inputs, outputs, constraints, and `entry_skill`                |
| `.aiworkforce/router.md`     | How to invoke the entry Skill and handle missing inputs or out-of-scope requests |
| `skills/<skill-id>/SKILL.md` | The method, checks, and output format for a task                                 |
| `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` | Plugin identifier, version, and description                                      |

For guidance that belongs to a session or repository, see [Agent instructions](/build/prompts-rules/).

## Build, test, and publish

Open **FDE workbench** (`/fde/`) in the console to build and publish. FDE users and administrators can enter the workbench. Administrators can also run [FDE Agent tests](/build/agent-tests/).
